description: Curated drug interaction pairs sourced from publicly available pharmacology references.

interactions.description: Warfarin and aspirin both affect blood clotting. Taking them together significantly increases the risk of bleeding.
interactions.recommendation: Do not combine without explicit medical supervision.
interactions.mechanism: Pharmacodynamic: both drugs inhibit clotting through different mechanisms.

interactions.description: NSAIDs like ibuprofen increase the risk of bleeding when taken with warfarin.
interactions.recommendation: Avoid combination. Use acetaminophen as an alternative pain reliever if approved by your doctor.
interactions.mechanism: Pharmacodynamic: NSAIDs impair platelet function and damage GI mucosa.

interactions.description: ACE inhibitors like lisinopril can increase potassium levels. Adding potassium supplements can cause dangerous hyperkalemia.
interactions.recommendation: Do not take potassium supplements with ACE inhibitors without medical supervision.
interactions.mechanism: Pharmacodynamic: ACE inhibitors reduce aldosterone secretion, decreasing potassium excretion.

interactions.description: Alcohol increases the risk of lactic acidosis with metformin.
interactions.recommendation: Limit or avoid alcohol while taking metformin.
interactions.mechanism: Pharmacodynamic: alcohol impairs lactate metabolism in the liver.

interactions.description: Combining benzodiazepines with opioids significantly increases risk of fatal respiratory depression.
interactions.recommendation: Avoid combination when possible. FDA warns against co-prescribing.
interactions.mechanism: Pharmacodynamic: additive CNS and respiratory depression.

interactions.description: Combined use causes a dangerous drop in blood pressure that can be fatal.
interactions.recommendation: Never take sildenafil with any nitrate medication.

interactions.description: Ibuprofen can reduce the antiplatelet effect of low-dose aspirin.
interactions.recommendation: Take ibuprofen at least 8 hours before or 30 minutes after low-dose aspirin.
interactions.mechanism: Pharmacodynamic: ibuprofen competitively blocks aspirin's access to COX-1.
